title: Field extension
statement: Let $k$ be a field. A *field extension* $k'/k$ is a field $k'$ together with a ring homomorphism $k\to k'$; such a homomorphism is injective, so $k$ is identified with its image and one writes $k\subseteq k'$. Equivalently, a field extension of $k$ is a $k$-algebra that is a field. The ring homomorphism $k\to k'$ induces the morphism of schemes $\operatorname{Spec}k'\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], which makes $\operatorname{Spec}k'$ a scheme over $k$ [def-weil-scheme-over-base].
